title: Feature Engineering and Sequences
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of spatiotemporal inputs and preprocessing, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in crop-yield-prediction.
learning_objectives: Explain spatiotemporal inputs and preprocessing in plain language and connect it to cyp/data/preprocessing.py; cyp/data/feature_engineering.py.
Trace one input through the feature engineering and sequences stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the feature engineering and sequences stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for spatiotemporal inputs and preprocessing.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
